name: Grakk Torr

greeting.stranger: You're not supposed to be here. This is private property.
greeting.acquaintance: You again? I told you, I don't know anything.
greeting.friend: Look, I can't talk. The syndicate is watching.
greeting.confidant: Alright, you've proven yourself. The refugees... they came from a place called Compound 7-Alpha. The syndicate was paid to keep quiet about it. That's all I know.

questRelated.iia_sytha_02_mines_investigation: I don't know what you're talking about. We run a legitimate mining operation here. Now get out before I call security.
questRelated.iia_sytha_02_mines_investigation_confron: You have the datapad? Fine. You want the truth? The refugees came from Compound 7-Alpha. The syndicate was paid to keep quiet about it. They took workers from here, sent them to that compound, and we were told to keep our mouths shut. I don't know what happened to them there, but I know it wasn't good. That's all I know. Now leave me alone—I've said too much already.

general: The mines are dangerous. You shouldn't be here.
We follow all regulations. Everything is above board.
I've got work to do. Don't waste my time.
The syndicate pays well. That's all that matters.

appearance.distinguishingFeatures: Scarred hands from mining work, cybernetic right arm

biography: Grakk Torr is the foreman of the Syndicate Mines on Sytha. A hard man who's worked in mining his entire life, he's loyal to the syndicate that pays him well. He knows more about the Compound 7-Alpha connection than he lets on, but fear and greed keep him silent. He's not inherently evil, but he's made his choice, and he'll defend it.
